title: OpenAI Branch
description: The OpenAI branch, which uses the chat completions shape you already know from the REST activity and Bearer-token auth.

steps.description: Enter the OpenAI branch. Throw if no API key is set, then pick the configured model or fall back to the default for OpenAI.
Post to `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`. The comment marks the `authorization` header as Bearer-token auth, which differs from Anthropic's `x-api-key`.
The body sends the model, the `messages` array, `max_completion_tokens`, and `temperature`.
Parse the JSON response with a raw-text fallback, and throw an error when the response is not ok or carries an error field.
Return `extractOpenAIText(data).trim()`. The comment says it reads `choices[0].message.content` defensively.
